name: zdi_build_pick_candidate_for_query_point
description: zDi::BuildPickCandidateForQueryPoint tests model faces against a point-query XZ coordinate and emits one below-query candidate.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel/zClass DI point-query source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x484960 validates null/empty rejection, optional blend-vertex path, current-matrix transform or identity copy into shared scratch, face vertex gather, TryGetPolygonHitAtQueryXZ dispatch, query-y ceiling check, variant-tag copy, scene-payload assignment, first-hit return 1, and miss return 0.
The native DI point-query smoke verifies a successful triangle hit below the query point, scene payload and variant tag copy, and rejection when the query Y is below the hit.
